title: DEVNAME and session collision semantics
summary: Explicit device identity is strict: when a requested device is busy, report DEVICE_COLLISION rather than silently substituting another device. Ordinary PUB400 work should prefer server-assigned device identity unless reconnect semantics are being tested.
invariants: STRICT device request never silently advances QPADEVnnnn.
A failed strict attempt closes the new socket rather than leaving another IBM i display session.
Device/session limits are operational evidence, not permission to create fallback sessions.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
